headline: Blended ROAS was 6.91 in Q3 2026 against 7.48 in Q2 2026 (-7.6%): ad spend grew 25.3% and store revenue 15.8%.
TikTok Ads spend went from $2,100 to $6,900, but only 19.9% of its clicks reach GA4 as tiktok / paid sessions (C2), so its return can't be judged yet.
Google Ads, Meta and Microsoft Ads claim 1.63 times the purchase value GA4 credits to their clicks (C4), so their dashboards overstate their own return by about 63%.

Store revenue over total ad spend. Revenue includes orders no ad touched, so read it as a marketing efficiency ratio and a trend, not a platform score.

warns_and_fails.detail: TikTok Ads Q3 2026: 15,600 clicks, 3,100 matched paid sessions (19.9% of clicks); TikTok Ads Q2 2026: 5,200 clicks, 1,100 matched paid sessions (21.2% of clicks).
warns_and_fails.meaning: Most TikTok ad clicks arrive in GA4 without the tiktok / paid tags, so GA4 can't credit its visits or purchases to it. Its site-side cost per purchase, CAC, mix index and ROI are not shown, and it is left out of the over-claim ratio.

warns_and_fails.detail: Q3 2026: the platforms claim $275,900 of purchase value, GA4 credits $169,200 to their paid sessions, a ratio of 1.63; Q2 2026: the platforms claim $236,700 of purchase value, GA4 credits $145,200 to their paid sessions, a ratio of 1.63.
warns_and_fails.meaning: The platforms claim about 63% more value than the site saw from their clicks in Q3 2026: they count the same orders more than once and add view-through credit. Use the site-side columns to compare channels.

headline: On gross margin, full-cost marketing ROI was -22.9% in Q3 2026 (-18.4% in Q2 2026). On revenue the same quarter shows 75.1%, the figure that overstates the return.
Ad spend alone returned 20.5% on margin; the $35,200 of non-media cost (36.1% of the total, most of it team time) turns that into a loss in the quarter.

A new customer cost $86 at full cost and pays it back in about 9.8 months of gross margin from that customer's orders (an estimate from the 12-month revenue per customer), against 9.4 months in Q2 2026.

formulas: Total marketing cost = ad spend + agency and freelance + content and creative + tools + events + team time
Full-cost ROI on revenue = (credited revenue - total marketing cost) / total marketing cost
Full-cost ROI on gross margin = (credited revenue x gross margin % - total marketing cost) / total marketing cost
Gross margin per $1 of cost = credited revenue x gross margin % / total marketing cost
Media-only ROI on gross margin = (credited revenue x gross margin % - ad spend) / ad spend
Break-even credited revenue = total marketing cost / gross margin %
Full-cost CAC = total marketing cost / credited new customers
Payback months = full-cost CAC / (12-month revenue per new customer x gross margin % / 12)

what_to_do.action: Fix TikTok tagging before judging it: add utm_source=tiktok&utm_medium=paid to every ad link and check that the in-app browser keeps them. It cost $9,060 in Q3 2026 with fees, and GA4 can see only a fifth of its clicks.
